status: placeholder static drawing; Codex to animate
method: Deterministic procedural drawing: each animal is one small 3D model of ellipsoids and flat polygon slabs, ray-cast from a fixed overhead camera (image_up = 0.82*y + 0.36*z) with a fixed light, 3x supersampled, quantised to palette ramps with ordered dithering, 1 px #151b19 outline. S/E/N are separate renders of the same model (consistent light); W is the exact mirror of E. Corpse = same model in an opisthotonic pose rolled onto its side with decayed colours; skeleton = vertebrae, ribs, skull and limb bones of the same pose.

conventions.live: 144x144 RGBA, origin/body anchor (hip) 72,72, directions S N E W like assets/enemy_full and assets/player_full
conventions.corpse_skeleton: 144x144 RGBA, E orientation, like assets/corpses/<species>_decayed_E_0.png and <species>_skeleton_E_0.png (origin 72,72); carcass bbox centred near 74,78 like the existing props; skeleton shares the corpse registration
conventions.avatar: 64x64 RGBA, origin 32,32, head only, like assets/avatars/<species>_idle_000.png

not_wired: No game code, project.json or runtime manifest references these files.
